evidence: bare_number_card: In seg2:start each species is just a percentage in a flat circle (97%, 90%, 90%), and seg3:start/seg3:end are a big '$53B' printed inside a blue disc.

weakest_scene.visible_evidence: seg2:start shows three flat circles labelled 97% / 90% / 90%. seg2:mid then cuts to three rows, each with its own copy of Data, plus two stray cyan rings sitting on a divider line. At seg2:end the percentages are text at the end of each row with nothing being lost.
weakest_scene.root_cause: The collapse is drawn as a ranking chart of percentages with the mascot cloned per row, so nothing on screen shows 97% of a population disappearing. The story's most brutal number has no physics.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Make the colony itself the picture: a cave ceiling packed with roosting bats, 100 per species, that empties as white fuzz spreads across them until only 3 of 100 northern long-eared bats remain (10 for the others). Data is the one sweeping or counting the survivors, with one mascot and no stray rings, and the 97% is readable as the gap left on the ceiling.
